name: Niku Choukyou ~Boku no Megami ga Niku Dorei~
original_name: 肉調教～僕の女神が肉奴隷～
source:
She has no girl friends, and even the boys who follow her around don't truly love her...
But even so, from the bottom of my heart, I always thought of her as a goddess.....

....until that incident.

She had seemed beyond my reach....
But now, all she is to me is tasty looking flesh.

The ultimate slave master simulation game!!
A protagonist who's always stepped on and treated like a servant turns the tables!
Make her play ero-games and gal games to get her in the mood, and gradually make her
a sex slave.

.....Your strange and wonderful master-slave training life starts here....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ097533.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
